no23.summary: Dana, waiting in vain for the Russian court to receive him, explains why he cannot predict the outcome: in an Administration not guided by settled principles or system nothing can be counted on, what the Minister adopt in this hour may be opposed by another influence in the next, and properly speaking there is no Minister here. One group (29) is open.
no23.en:
[I]n an [Administration] like this, which [i]s not guided by an[y] settled principles or system, you can be certain of no measure.

What the [Minister] adopt in this hour may be opposed by an irresistab[le] influ[e]nce in the next.

In short, properly speaking, there is no [Minister] here.

Hence my present difficulty.
